g.text: Lectern targets macOS. The TUI, whisper.cpp and Ollama work here, but system-audio capture
Whisper runs without Metal acceleration on this architecture and will be slower.
uv sync --extra audio (and 'brew install portaudio' if that fails)
brew install ffmpeg (only needed to import non-WAV audio)
It will be written on first run, or run 'lectern config init'.
2 problem(s) need attention before Lectern can record.
Transcription needs whisper.cpp and a Whisper model before you can record.
